title: Sloth bear cubs ride piggyback
caption:
The only bus route with fur seats.

About 20,000 or fewer sloth bears may remain in the wild, though no reliable large-scale survey has been done.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; Animal Diversity Web. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
